documents.title: OCI Cloud Guard review pattern
documents.content: Review Cloud Guard findings, validate context, and assign remediation through approved change management.

documents.title: RAG source approval rule
documents.content: Retrieve only from approved, classified knowledge sources and cite the source in the analyst response.

documents.title: Human approval boundary
documents.content: The agent can recommend a remediation but cannot change IAM, network, or production resources automatically.
